title: I'm a Celebrity returns to ITV on Monday
summary: Ant and Dec are back in the Australian jungle. The official line-up has not been announced.
body:
The new series of I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! starts on Monday 16 November at 9 p.m. on ITV1 and ITVX, the broadcaster has confirmed.

Ant and Dec return to present the show live from the Australian jungle.

Who is going in?

ITV has not yet announced the campmates. British newspapers including The Sun have reported a list of twelve names, among them former England footballer Wayne Rooney, presenter AJ Odudu and actress Joanna Page. None of these has been confirmed by ITV.

The broadcaster usually reveals the official line-up a few days before the first episode.

Sources: ITV, Capital XTRA, Energy Radio.
